credentials.description: service ID — the user part of HTTP Basic auth, base64(SERVICE_ID:SECRET_TOKEN)
secret token — the password part of HTTP Basic auth

sms_balance.description: Available SMS balance (in number of SMS). Use this field — 'balance' is deprecated.

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL configured for SMS status notifications.

gotchas: The 'balance' field is DEPRECATED — use 'sms_balance' for the SMS balance. Both are returned but 'balance' will be removed in a future version.
sms_balance is in number of SMS (units), not in GNF. A balance of 100 means 100 SMS available.
Check the balance before any bulk send — an insufficient balance returns a 400 error with the 'solde' field in send_message's error response.
open_questions: Sandbox: provider.json declares none and no gotcha documents a test environment — every call reaches production.
